title: Inverse scattering in an asymptotically flat multilayer domain
summary: We consider a scattering problem for a wave equation $\partial_t^2 u = \frac{1}{\sqrt{g}}\partial_i(\sqrt{g}g^{ij}\partial_j)u$ in a multilayer domain $Ω\subset {\bf R}^{n+1}_x = {\bf R}^n_y \times {\bf R}^1_{x^{n+1}}$ of the form $Ω= \mathcal K \cup Ω_1 \cup \cdots \cup Ω_N$, where $\mathcal K$ is a bounded open set and $Ω_k$ is asymptotically equal to a slab domain ${\bf R}^n \times (c_k,c_k + d_k)$ as $|y| \to \infty$.
